scope: L3 Tooling & L8 Agentic Swarm: Prefix-Pinned Context & Bionic Delta Envelope across 5 Harnesses

dependency.rationale: Root prerequisite node in the W1-W6 DAG; unblocks W2 (P1, score 3125) and transitive waves W3-W6.

impact.rationale: Eliminates full-file re-reads via SHA-256 prefix pinning and delta-only MCIP-v1 envelopes.

fmea_modes.effect: Cross-harness epistemic divergence and redundant token burn
fmea_modes.controls: SHA-256 prefix-pinned context cache + MCIP-v1 delta envelope verification

fmea_modes.cause: Stale cache entry served after underlying Jujutsu revision changes
fmea_modes.effect: Agent acts on superseded file state
fmea_modes.controls: Candidate commit SHA-256 invalidation guard + fail-closed digest check

ucas.context: Prefix digest binding is omitted when dispatching a cross-harness sub-task.
ucas.constraint: SC-W1-1: Every cross-harness frame MUST carry a non-empty SHA-256 prefix digest.

ucas.context: Cached prefix is provided with a mismatched candidate revision digest.
ucas.constraint: SC-W1-2: Reject any cached prefix whose candidate SHA-256 differs from live HEAD.

ucas.context: Delta envelope is applied before base prefix snapshot is verified.
ucas.constraint: SC-W1-3: Enforce causal sequence: verify base prefix digest before applying delta.

ucas.context: Pinned prefix lease is retained too long across epoch boundary.
ucas.constraint: SC-W1-4: Expire prefix cache leases automatically on epoch or Jujutsu revision advance.

decision.summary: Pull W1 first as the sole dependency-ready root prerequisite unblocking W2 (score 3125) and the entire W1-W6 holonic DAG.
alternatives: Execute W2 directly without prefix-pinned context
Defer Bionic delta envelopes until after W4 cockpit
counterevidence: Initial cache warmup still incurs one full read per artifact before prefix pinning activates.
assumptions: All 5 harnesses share read access to canonical SHA-256 digest descriptors.
decision.forecast: Reduces cross-harness prompt payload re-transmission by >= 60% while guaranteeing SHA-256 prefix parity.
decision.falsifier: Any cross-harness frame accepted with an empty or mismatched SHA-256 prefix digest.
decision.rollback: Revert to full-payload read_file dispatch and invalidate prefix cache table.
decision.budget: 1 wave slice (<= 15m wall clock, 0 paid external API calls)
residuals: Cold-start cache miss requires initial full read before prefix pinning takes effect.

stpa_analysis.controller: L0/L1 Cost-Aware Execution Governor & Permit Gate
losses: L-1: Unauthorized state mutation outside Sa-plan lease

ucas.context: Andon stop-line halt is not provided when worker lease_until_ns < now_ns.
ucas.constraint: SC-W2-1: Immediately abort any effect lacking a live Sa-plan lease.

ucas.context: Mutation permit is provided when token or retry budget is exhausted.
ucas.constraint: SC-W2-2: Refuse permit issuance whenever remaining budget <= 0.

ucas.context: Permit check occurs only at task claim time instead of effect execution time.
ucas.constraint: SC-W2-3: Re-verify (worker, attempt, lease_until_ns) atomically at effect time.

ucas.context: Execution lease is held too long by a stalled worker without heartbeat renewal.
ucas.constraint: SC-W2-4: Bound lease duration and require explicit monotonic renewal.

decision.summary: Highest intrinsic risk score (3125, P1); executes immediately once prerequisite W1 completes.
alternatives: Rely on claim-time lease check only
Enforce budgets only via post-hoc telemetry alerts
counterevidence: Claim-time-only checks fail when a worker stalls past lease_until_ns before committing an effect.
assumptions: SQLite WAL and monotonic clock receipts are available to the permit gate.
decision.forecast: 100% rejection of expired-lease or over-budget effect attempts with < 1ms gate latency.
decision.falsifier: Any state mutation succeeding when lease_until_ns < now_ns or budget_remaining == 0.
decision.rollback: Engage L0 Andon stop-line and freeze all non-read-only MCP routes.
residuals: Sub-millisecond clock skew between BEAM and SQLite is bounded by +1024ns guard.
